entries.name: Buffy Summers
entries.sourceWork: Buffy saison7, après retrait de la puce de Spike et avant la faux/amulette finale
entries.sourceReference: Buffy Summers, adult Slayer in season7 (2002–2003). Shoulder-length straight blonde hair, plain black sleeveless tank top, burgundy/maroon fitted full-length trousers, black shoes. Natural sharpened WOODEN STAKE in anatomical right hand only when preparing/attacking; small stake holster at right waist when hands free. No Scythe, no red amulet, no firearm or magic. Same mature natural proportions as reference, not chibi. Preserve viewed black top/burgundy trouser identity; add the actual wooden stake required by the selected actions, exclude later Scythe and amulet.

entries.name: Willow Rosenberg
entries.sourceWork: Buffy saison7, après retrait de la puce de Spike et avant la faux/amulette finale
entries.sourceReference: Willow Rosenberg, adult auburn-haired woman in Buffy season7, controlled protective witchcraft, NOT Dark Willow. Shoulder-length auburn hair, soft purple cardigan over a modest dark green top, full-length charcoal trousers and flat brown shoes. Normal eyes and skin; no black hair/veins. Empty hands, no gun, staff, glowing amulet or overalls. Old salopette is an earlier broad cue; choose ordinary adult season7 cardigan and trousers. No Dark Willow, finale white-hair Slayer activation or gun.

entries.name: Rupert Giles
entries.sourceWork: Buffy saison7, après retrait de la puce de Spike et avant la faux/amulette finale
entries.sourceReference: Rupert Giles, middle-aged human Watcher in Buffy season7. Short receding brown/grey hair, rectangular wire glasses, brown tweed jacket over grey waistcoat and pale shirt, dark red tie, brown trousers and sensible brown shoes. Physical wooden-and-dark-metal CROSSBOW with horizontal bow limbs and visible bolt rail; held in TWO hands. No gun, magical book laser or huge fantasy bow. Preserve human bespectacled brown-jacket Watcher identity but add a complete physical crossbow; no book beam or gun.

NO red/gold amulet, NO sword/stake/gun, no fire, wings, glowing veins, fangs closeup or vampire transformation. Remove old red amulet, swords and firecasting entirely; keep platinium hair and complete black leather duster. Physical fists/kicks only.

entries.sourceReference: Ron Weasley, sixth-year student Half-Blood Prince FILM2009, approximately16–17, tall slim fully clothed natural teen proportions, not chibi. Short tousled GINGER hair, freckles, white collared shirt, grey school V-neck pullover, Gryffindor RED/GOLD tie, full-length black trousers, black school shoes, open BLACK SCHOOL ROBE dark red lining. Thin wooden WAND in anatomical right hand: slender branch-like stick, NO trigger or gun barrel. No firearm or pistol anywhere. The old reference wrongly draws a handgun. Replace it completely with a slim wooden wand held as a wand, keeping red hair and HP6 uniform. No gun-shaped handle.

No purple/gold early-film robe, giant staff, gun, alchemist machine or youthful body. Correct old purple/gold robe to documented HP6 silver-grey costume; retain elderly beard/glasses and thin wand, no gun or huge purple laser. Dark right hand is source-specific, not a new injury mechanic.
